title: No path leaves the operator stuck
description: Every failure mode of the submit path routes to a local bundle file with a one-line message that names the reason, the repo URL to paste into, and where the bundle was written. gh missing, gh not logged in, repo unreachable, viewerPermission NONE on a private repo, issues disabled, create or comment failure and unresolved destination all map to a bundle rather than a stall. Bundled entries are terminal (not re-asked) so the operator is never nagged about the same finding; a hand-driven re-submit is supported for one entry once access exists.
